purpose: Capture per-wheel contact evidence on the exact 1 ms step of a future scan-motion discontinuity.

integration_facts.contact_sensor_entity: declares which wheel collision is monitored
integration_facts.contact_data_component: gz-sim stores ContactSensorData on the monitored collision entity, not on the sensor entity
integration_facts.dynamic_spawn_order: UserCommands must run before Contact; otherwise gz-sim EachNew can permanently miss dynamically spawned sensors (gazebosim/gz-sim#3295)
integration_facts.capture_enable_policy: all four sensors, wheel collisions and data components must be ready or capture enable fails with per-wheel entity diagnostics

controlled_verification.method: lower the residual threshold so a dump is certain; this tests the evidence path and is not a reproduction of the natural fault

stationary_cost_ab.scope: same 100 m rough marked v2 scene, headless OptiX, x=10 m, stationary; one run per case, so this is a smoke budget rather than tail-latency acceptance
stationary_cost_ab.reading: No material stationary RTF or whole-device VRAM regression was observed. A moving full mission remains the production acceptance.

analysis.grid_model: 10 cm cells split from low-low to high-high
reports: distance to the internal triangle diagonal
contact count, mean normal, maximum depth and maximum force changes from the preceding physics step
analysis.causality_rule: Edge proximity alone is not proof because a finite tyre patch normally spans multiple triangles. Confirmation requires the residual spike and a contact manifold / normal / depth / force discontinuity to coincide on the same wheel and step near an edge.

root_cause_status: The recorder is ready, but the natural intermittent fault has not recurred with v2 evidence. Rigid-tyre internal-edge contact remains the leading unproven mechanism.
